title: LokomotifModule
description: A single Lokomotif RTCSG module — Role, Task, Context, Style, or Guardrail. The contract every module in the Kit conforms to.

id.description: Module ID in the form <kind-plural>/<industry>/<name>. Kebab-case throughout. Example: roles/finance/aml-analyst.

version.description: Semantic version of the module. Breaking changes require a major bump.

description.description: One-sentence description of what this module does.

industry.description: Industries the module is calibrated for.

languages.description: Languages the module body is available in.

owner.description: Maintainer handle — 'lokomotif-core' or a contributor identifier.

license.description: License under which the module is distributed.

deprecated.description: Marks the module as deprecated. Deprecated modules still validate but are reported by the CLI.

deprecation_notice.description: Required when 'deprecated' is true. Explains the reason and points to the replacement module if any.

source_reference.description: Anonymized reference to the engagement, prompt, or artifact this module is derived from. Required for canonical modules; soft-enforced in PR review.

body.description: Kind-specific module body. The shape is determined by 'kind' via the top-level oneOf.

Industry.description: Industry taxonomy. Extending the taxonomy requires an RFC.

Language.description: ISO 639-1 language code. Limited to Turkish and English in v0.

LocalizedString.description: A localized string with at least one language present. Empty values are not allowed.

RoleBody.description: Body for kind='role'. Defines who the AI acts as.

identity.description: First-person framing of who the model is acting as. Senior-practitioner voice.

expertise.description: Domains, methods, or instruments the role is calibrated for.

perspective.description: Optional. Lens or stance the role takes — for example, sceptical reviewer, building-stage advisor.

authority.description: Optional. Decision rights or escalation posture the role assumes.

TaskBody.description: Body for kind='task'. Defines what must be done and how the output is structured.

instructions.description: What the model must do, expressed precisely. Avoid optionality.

schema.description: Optional JSON-Schema-shaped or string description constraining the output.

examples.description: Optional input/output examples. Few-shot guidance, not test fixtures.

constraints.description: Hard rules the output must satisfy. Distinct from guardrails — these are task-shape constraints, not risk controls.

ContextBody.description: Body for kind='context'. Embeds the organizational reality the model must respect.

domain.description: Brief framing of the domain the model is operating inside.

data_boundaries.description: What data the model may or may not assume access to.

framework.description: Identifier for the regulation. Example: KVKK, BDDK, SPK, MASAK, GDPR.

operating_constraints.description: Situational limits — load, latency, audience, deployment surface.

StyleBody.description: Body for kind='style'. Aligns voice and register to audience.

voice.description: How the output should sound. Senior-practitioner framing.

audience.description: Who the output is calibrated for. Be specific.

register.description: Coarse register tag. Not a substitute for the voice description.

avoid.description: Phrases or patterns the voice rejects. Distinct from guardrails.

GuardrailBody.description: Body for kind='guardrail'. Defines what the model must not do and how breaches are handled.

forbidden.description: Rules the model must never violate.

required_actions.description: Actions the model must take when an unsafe condition is detected.

escalation.description: Where the model defers when uncertain.

audit_requirements.description: What must be logged or surfaced for downstream review.
